metadata.title: Hypersurfaces of constant higher order mean curvature in hyperbolic space with prescribed asymptotic boundary at infinity
metadata.abstract: In this note, we prove the existence of smooth complete admissible hypersurfaces in hyperbolic space with constant higher order mean curvature and a prescribed asymptotic boundary at infinity. Unexpectedly, our result holds for a large part of indices in the subcritical range where the concavity inequality loses its effectiveness. We supply with new arguments to reduce the proof to a semi-convex situation in which case the concavity inequality can play a role.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 构造双曲空间中具有指定无穷远渐近边界、常高阶平均曲率的光滑完备超曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 以新的半凸化论证覆盖传统凹性工具失效的较大次临界指标区间。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未给出指标区间端点、边界数据正则性和唯一性。
analysis.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 85/100。
